Name: An Important Letter
Author: lv1bby
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b][u]About This Mod[/u][/b]
 Your wedding day is getting closer, and someone special has something to say.
[b]An Important Letter[/b] adds a heartfelt letter from your father, arriving two days after you accept a marriage proposal.
Although he cannot be there to celebrate this special day with you, he wants you to know how much he loves you and how proud he is of the person you've become.
Along with his letter, he sends you a special wedding gift to help you prepare for your big day.

[u][b]When Does the Letter Arrive?[/b][/u]
The letter arrives [b]two days after accepting a marriage proposal[/b], before your wedding day.

[b][u]Compatibility Note:[/u][/b] This mod currently works when marrying an NPC. Marriages between two player characters in multiplayer are not supported yet.

[size=4][b][u]Installation instructions[/u][/b][/size]
1-Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed
2-Download and extract An Important letter zip
3-Move the An Important Letter to your mods folder
4-Launch the game through SMAPI anddd you are all set!!!

[size=4][b][u]Main features[/u][/b][/size]
[*]Unique letters for female and male farmers.[/*]
[*]A heartfelt message from your father.[/*]
[*]Special wedding outfit gifts.[/*]
[*]10,000g as a wedding gift.

[size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size][/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher

[size=4][b][u]Shout outs[/u][/b][/size]
A little note from me:
This is my first ever mod and english isn't my first language, so please forgive any mistakes or awkward wording.
I didn't want to create anything too big. I just wanted to add a small, sweet detail to Stardew Valley and make the wedding experience a little more special.
I'd really love to hear your thoughts and feedback, so feel free to leave a comment!
Thank you so much for giving my little mod a try. It truly means a lot to me! 💗😼😼
— Lvubby[/*]
